request.style: English, warm female soul voice, solo with gentle choir, acoustic piano, electric bass, fingerpicked guitar, soft drums, hopeful and resilient mood, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Now we know that you know everything
No one needs to question you
Because of this we believe
You came from God today

[Pre-Chorus]
Do you believe now I ask you
The hour is coming soon
It has already come to us
When you will be scattered

[Chorus]
In me you may have peace
In the world you will have trouble
But take heart my soul
I have overcome the world

[Verse]
Each to his own home you go
You will leave me alone
Yet I am not alone friend
For the Father is with me

[Chorus]
In me you may have peace
In the world you will have trouble
But take heart my soul
I have overcome the world

[Bridge]
I have told you these things
So that in me you may have peace
Look up and find rest
In the truth I hold

[Chorus]
In me you may have peace
In the world you will have trouble
But take heart my soul
I have overcome the world

[Outro]
Take heart and stand firm
I have overcome
